description: Four-channel mixer for audio or CV, with a straight output and an inverted one

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the mix, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: A signal into the mix, scaled by that channel's level knob

outputs.text: The four channels added together, with no clipping
The four channels added together and inverted, with no clipping

notes: all four level knobs come up fully down, so the outputs stay silent until at least one is turned up.
